versions.content: Service Name UdpNm_DeactivateTxPnShutdownMsg Syntax Std_ReturnType UdpNm_DeactivateTxPnShutdownMsg ( NetworkHandleType nmChannelHandle ) Service ID [hex] 0xf5 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different nmChannelHandle. Non reentrant for the same nmChannelHandle. Parameters (in) nmChannelHandle Identifier of the NM-Channel where the PNC shutdown process is stopped. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK:Request has been accepted. E_NOT_OK: Request has not been accepted. Description NM indicate to deactive the transmission of PN shutdown messages on the given NM-Channel. This result in transmission of a usual NM-PDUs with PNSR bit set to 0. Available via UdpNm.h
